description: Initiate a VoiceFlip account signup for a business. Returns an agentic signup intent token and the next action: Stripe Shared Payment Token (when Stripe Agentic Commerce is configured), a test-checkout instruction when AGENTIC_ALLOW_TEST_CHECKOUT=1, or a human Stripe Checkout URL. After payment, call vf_get_signup_status with the same intent token to retrieve the API key, agent id, and embed snippet. Public, rate-limited per IP. Locale `ae` quotes AED.
name: vf_signup
